title: 重新排列日志文件
summary: 日志首字段是标识符；字母日志按内容再按标识符排序并置前，数字日志保持原相对顺序置后。
insight: 比较器先区分内容首字符是否为数字；两个字母日志比较去掉标识符后的内容，再比较标识符，数字日志比较为相等以保留稳定顺序。
pitfalls: 字母日志排序不包含标识符作为首关键字
内容相同时才比较标识符
数字日志之间必须稳定

solutions.title: 稳定自定义日志排序
solutions.idea: 按日志类型和题设键建立比较器。
steps: 为日志定位第一个空格并判断内容类型
字母对字母先比较 content，后比较 identifier
字母排数字之前，数字对数字返回零并用稳定排序

code.java: class Solution { public String[] reorderLogFiles(String[] logs){Arrays.sort(logs,(a,b)->{int sa=a.indexOf(' '),sb=b.indexOf(' ');boolean da=Character.isDigit(a.charAt(sa+1)),db=Character.isDigit(b.charAt(sb+1));if(da&&db)return 0;if(da!=db)return da?1:-1;int byContent=a.substring(sa+1).compareTo(b.substring(sb+1));return byContent!=0?byContent:a.substring(0,sa).compareTo(b.substring(0,sb));});return logs;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun reorderLogFiles(logs:Array<String>):Array<String>{return logs.withIndex().sortedWith(Comparator{a,b->val sa=a.value.indexOf(' ');val sb=b.value.indexOf(' ');val da=a.value[sa+1].isDigit();val db=b.value[sb+1].isDigit();if(da&&db)a.index-b.index else if(da!=db)if(da)1 else -1 else{val content=a.value.substring(sa+1).compareTo(b.value.substring(sb+1));if(content!=0)content else a.value.substring(0,sa).compareTo(b.value.substring(0,sb))}}).map{it.value}.toTypedArray()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> reorderLogFiles(vector<string>& logs){stable_sort(logs.begin(),logs.end(),[](const string& a,const string& b){int sa=a.find(' '),sb=b.find(' ');bool da=isdigit(a[sa+1]),db=isdigit(b[sb+1]);if(da&&db)return false;if(da!=db)return !da;string ca=a.substr(sa+1),cb=b.substr(sb+1);return ca==cb?a.substr(0,sa)<b.substr(0,sb):ca<cb;});return logs;} };
